items.title: Franklin Templeton digital asset veteran takes helm at StablecoinX
items.summary: Former Franklin Templeton digital asset executive Christopher Jensen will lead StablecoinX, the largest corporate holder of Ethena’s ENA token.

items.title: $47M Still Missing After Liquid Hack as Blockstream Bargains With 'White Hats'
items.summary: The hackers have returned 3,400 of the roughly 4,000 BTC drained from the sidechain, but about 600 BTC remains outstanding—and some doubt the actors' "white hat" claims.

items.title: Hyperliquid open interest climbs to $14.3 billion as HYPE hits all-time high
Compound Opens Institutional-Only Lending Market
items.summary: The market lends USDC against ETH, wstETH, WBTC and cbBTC to whitelisted institutions only, at loan-to-value ratios of up to 87%.
